doc.brief: GtkShortcutType specifies the kind of shortcut that is being described.
doc.md:
GtkShortcutType specifies the kind of shortcut that is being described.

More values may be added to this enumeration over time.

accelerator.brief: The shortcut is a keyboard accelerator.
accelerator.md:
The shortcut is a keyboard accelerator. The GtkShortcutsShortcut:accelerator
  property will be used.

gesture.md:
The shortcut is a gesture. The GtkShortcutsShortcut:icon property will be
  used.

gesture_pinch.brief: The shortcut is a pinch gesture.
gesture_pinch.md: The shortcut is a pinch gesture. GTK provides an icon and subtitle.

gesture_rotate_clockwise.brief: The shortcut is a clockwise rotation gesture.
gesture_rotate_clockwise.md: The shortcut is a clockwise rotation gesture. GTK provides an icon and subtitle.

gesture_rotate_counterclockwise.brief: The shortcut is a counterclockwise rotation gesture.
gesture_rotate_counterclockwise.md: The shortcut is a counterclockwise rotation gesture. GTK provides an icon and subtitle.

gesture_stretch.brief: The shortcut is a stretch gesture.
gesture_stretch.md: The shortcut is a stretch gesture. GTK provides an icon and subtitle.

gesture_swipe_left.brief: The shortcut is a swipe gesture.
gesture_swipe_left.md: The shortcut is a swipe gesture. GTK provides an icon and subtitle.

gesture_swipe_right.brief: The shortcut is a swipe gesture.
gesture_swipe_right.md: The shortcut is a swipe gesture. GTK provides an icon and subtitle.

gesture_two_finger_swipe_left.brief: The shortcut is a two-finger swipe gesture.
gesture_two_finger_swipe_left.md: The shortcut is a two-finger swipe gesture. GTK provides an icon and subtitle.

gesture_two_finger_swipe_right.brief: The shortcut is a two-finger swipe gesture.
gesture_two_finger_swipe_right.md: The shortcut is a two-finger swipe gesture. GTK provides an icon and subtitle.
